sentences.en: Adam Goldman, who is John Bennett?
sentences.zh: 亚当·戈德曼，约翰·班内特是谁？

sentences.en: John Bennett was one of America's top spies.
sentences.zh: 约翰·班内特是美国顶级间谍之一。

sentences.en: He also was in charge of the National Clandestine
sentences.zh: 当奥巴马总统下令在2011年突袭巴基斯坦境内乌萨马·本·拉丹的据点时，他还负责中情局的间谍部门——国家秘密

sentences.en: Service, the spy arm of the CIA, when President Obama ordered the raid on the Osama bin Laden compound in Pakistan in 2011.
sentences.zh: 行动处。

sentences.en: So how unusual is it that someone of Bennett's status, especially in such a clandestine world, sits down and talks with you on the record in front of a microphone?
sentences.zh: 那么，像班内特这样地位的人，尤其是在这样一个隐秘的世界里，坐下来在麦克风前公开接受你的采访，这有多罕见？

sentences.en: It's something he has rarely done since he left the agency in 2013.
sentences.zh: 自从他2013年离开中情局以来，他很少这样做。

sentences.en: In fact, I've tried to contact
sentences.zh: 事实上，我曾试图联系

sentences.en: John and he has not responded.
sentences.zh: 约翰，但他没有回复。

sentences.en: So then why is he talking to you now?
sentences.zh: 那他现在为什么要跟你谈？

sentences.en: Like any good spy, John has a mission.
sentences.zh: 像任何优秀的间谍一样，约翰肩负着使命。

sentences.en: He wants to get the word out about Gina Haspel, who's been nominated to be the director of the CIA.
sentences.zh: 他想宣传吉娜·哈斯佩尔，她已被提名担任中情局局长。

sentences.en: And what do we need to know about Gina Haspel?
sentences.zh: 关于吉娜·哈斯佩尔，我们需要了解什么？

sentences.en: I think it's important to know about Gina Haspel that she is a highly respected case officer who joined the CIA in 1985.
sentences.zh: 我认为了解吉娜·哈斯佩尔很重要的一点是，她是一名备受尊敬的案情官员，于1985年加入中情局。

sentences.en: And the CIA has been running an aggressive campaign to get the word out about her.
sentences.zh: 中情局一直在开展积极的宣传活动，以宣传她的情况。

sentences.en: They've been relying on Twitter, news releases, giving information reporters who have written lengthy stories about her.
sentences.zh: 他们一直依靠推特、新闻稿，向撰写了关于她的长篇报道的记者提供信息。

sentences.en: And part of this public relations campaign is getting former agency employees, people like John Bennett, to talk to reporters.
sentences.zh: 这场公关活动的一部分就是让前局雇员，像约翰·班内特这样的人，接受记者采访。

sentences.en: And why would they have to do that or want to do that?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要这么做，或者说为什么想要这么做？

sentences.en: Why do they need to get out the good word on this CIA official?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们需要为这位中情局官员说好话？

sentences.en: Because there's really only one story that's been told about Gina Haspel's history in the CIA.
sentences.zh: 因为关于吉娜·哈斯佩尔在中情局的历史，实际上只有一个故事在流传。

sentences.en: And that story is about her role running a CIA black site where an al-Qaeda suspect was tortured and her role in helping destroy tapes of these tortured possessions.
sentences.zh: 那个故事是关于她负责管理一个中情局黑监狱，并在那里折磨了一名基地组织嫌疑人，以及她协助销毁这些酷刑录像带的角色。

sentences.en: Haspel was seen as a very competent case officer.
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔被视为一名非常能干的案情官员。

sentences.en: Prior to 9-11, she was the deputy station chief in Ankara, Turkey.
sentences.zh: 9·11事件之前，她是土耳其安卡拉的副站长。

sentences.en: But after 9-11, she began working in the CIA's counterterrorism center.
sentences.zh: 但9·11事件后，她开始在中情局的反恐中心工作。

sentences.en: It was a little sleepy prior to 9-11, but after 9-11, it was infused with the agency's best talent and billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 9·11之前它有点冷清，但在9·11之后，它注入了该机构最优秀的人才和数十亿美元资金。

sentences.en: And the counterterrorism center was, in fact, in charge of waging war against al-Qaeda and interrogating detaining suspects in secret prisons around the world.
sentences.zh: 事实上，反恐中心负责对基地组织发动战争，并在全球各地的秘密监狱中审讯和拘留嫌疑人。

sentences.en: What do you know, Adam, about Haspel's specific role in the counterterrorism center after 9-11?
sentences.zh: 亚当，关于9·11之后哈斯佩尔在反恐中心的具体角色，你知道些什么？

sentences.en: I know when she joined, she was put in charge of surveillance teaMs. While doing that job, the CIA asked her to go to Thailand to be what is known as a base chief.
sentences.zh: 我知道她加入时，被任命负责监视小组。在做这项工作期间，中情局要求她去泰国担任所谓的基地长官。

sentences.en: She was actually put in charge of this secret prison in Thailand, which is about two hours outside of Bangkok.
sentences.zh: 她实际上负责管理这个位于曼谷郊外约两小时车程的秘密监狱。

sentences.en: It was an infamous site.
sentences.zh: 那是一个声名狼藉的地方。

sentences.en: There were two individuals brought there.
sentences.zh: 有两个人被带到了那里。

sentences.en: One, an al-Qaeda suspect named Abu Zubaydah, and another al-Qaeda suspect named Abda al-Rahim al-Nashiri.
sentences.zh: 一个是基地组织嫌疑人阿布·祖拜达，另一个是基地组织嫌疑人阿卜杜勒·拉希姆·纳什里。

sentences.en: Zubaydah was waterboarded 83 times.
sentences.zh: 祖拜达被实施了83次水刑。

sentences.en: At this site?
sentences.zh: 在这个地方？

sentences.en: At this site.
sentences.zh: 在这个地方。

sentences.en: The first al-Qaeda prisoner to be waterboarded was Abu Zubaydah.
sentences.zh: 第一个被施以水刑的基地组织囚犯是阿布·祖拜达。

sentences.en: These enhanced interrogation techniques were designed to break the prisoners, and Abu Zubaydah was to be the guinea pig.
sentences.zh: 这些强化审讯技术的目的在于摧毁囚犯的意志，而阿布·祖拜达就是试验品。

sentences.en: Abu Zubaydah, repeatedly waterboarded, became completely unresponsive, with bubbles rising through his open, full mouth.
sentences.zh: 阿布·祖拜达遭到反复水刑，变得完全没有反应，气泡从他张开的饱满嘴里冒出来。

sentences.en: He actually had to be resuscitated.
sentences.zh: 他实际上不得不被实施心肺复苏。

sentences.en: He actually died on the waterboard.
sentences.zh: 他实际上在水刑中死去了。

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: But was revived.
sentences.zh: 但被救活了。

sentences.en: But was revived.
sentences.zh: 但被救活了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And after he was waterboarded and exposed to these harsh interrogation techniques, it's my understanding that Haspel arrived.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，在他遭受水刑和这些严厉审讯技术后，哈斯佩尔抵达了。

sentences.en: And she was there for about six weeks.
sentences.zh: 她在那里呆了大约六周。

sentences.en: And while she was running this secret prison, Nashiri was waterboarded three times and also exposed to some of these very harsh techniques.
sentences.zh: 在她管理这座秘密监狱期间，纳什里被实施了三次水刑，并接触了一些非常严厉的技术。

sentences.en: I don't know anybody who joined CIA to run an interrogation center.
sentences.zh: 我不认识任何人加入中情局是为了运营审讯中心的。

sentences.en: It's not a job we were trained for.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们受过培训的工作。

sentences.en: It's not a job we had the experience for.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们有经验的工作。

sentences.en: But it was a job we were asked to do in the moments of greatest uncertainty and anxiety in the aftermath of 9-11.
sentences.zh: 但在9·11事件后充满最大不确定性和焦虑的时刻，这是要求我们去做的工作。

sentences.en: So Gina and others did their duty as it was defined for them at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以吉娜和其他人履行了当时为他们定义的职责。

sentences.en: I think Bennett, like many people in the CIA, realized that they needed to take action.
sentences.zh: 我认为班内特和中情局的许多人一样，意识到他们需要采取行动。

sentences.en: And it had to be robuSt. And they needed to take the fight to al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 而且必须是强有力的。他们需要把战斗带给基地组织。

sentences.en: That was the thinking then.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法就是这样。

sentences.en: They could be possibly facing another devastating terrorism attack.
sentences.zh: 他们可能面临另一次毁灭性的恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: And they didn't want that to happen.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让那种事发生。

sentences.en: You know, I thought that they were certainly unprecedented in extreme measures, but it was an extreme situation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这些肯定是前所未有的极端措施，但当时情况极端。

sentences.en: And Franklin Donald Roosevelt interned thousands of loyal

sentences.zh: 约翰·亚当斯签署了《客籍法和煽动叛乱

sentences.en: Acts.
American presidents, when they've been faced with an extreme threat, have taken extreme actions, which oftentimes, in retrospect, were seen as incompatible with our core values.
sentences.zh: 美国总统在面临极端威胁时，曾采取过极端行动，回过头来看，这些行动往往被认为与我们的核心价值观不相容。

sentences.en: So I think this probably falls in that category.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这可能属于那一类。

sentences.en: It was an extreme reaction to an extreme event.
sentences.zh: 这是对极端事件的极端反应。

sentences.en: On a personal level, is this something you would have taken part of?
sentences.zh: 从个人的角度来看，这是你会参与的事情吗？

sentences.en: Is this something you would have done?
sentences.zh: 这是你会做的事吗？

sentences.en: I would have carried out my duties as they were defined at the time.
sentences.zh: 我会履行当时所定义的职责。

sentences.en: What about waterboarding our confinement box?
sentences.zh: 水刑或禁闭箱呢？

sentences.en: Waterboarding, I think that's where you get over the line.
sentences.zh: 水刑，我认为那就是越界的地方。

sentences.en: And why is waterboarding the line that for Bennett, and maybe for others, cannot or should not be crossed?
sentences.zh: 为什么水刑是对班内特（也许对其他人）来说不能或不应该跨越的界限？

sentences.en: What is it about waterboarding?
sentences.zh: 水刑到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Well, waterboarding itself simulates drowning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，水刑本身就是模拟溺水。

sentences.en: So you're actually creating the sensation of drowning, of death.
sentences.zh: 所以你实际上是在制造溺水、死亡的感觉。

sentences.en: And that itself, under international law, is prohibited.
sentences.zh: 而这本身根据国际法是禁止的。

sentences.en: So what Bennett is saying is that he's conflicted about some of these tactics, at least when it comes to waterboarding.
sentences.zh: 所以班内特的意思是，他对其中一些战术感到矛盾，至少在涉及水刑时是这样。

sentences.en: Do we know whether Haspel is similarly conflicted about what she is doing during this post-9-11 period?
sentences.zh: 我们是否知道哈斯佩尔对她在9·11后这段时期所做的事情是否也感到矛盾？

sentences.en: One of the mysteries of Haspel is what she thought at the time and what she thinks now.
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔的一个谜团是她当时的想法以及她现在的想法。

sentences.en: Haspel has never spoken publicly about her time in this black site, about her time overseeing waterboarding.
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔从未公开谈论过她在黑监狱的经历，以及她监督水刑的经历。

sentences.en: We don't know from Haspel herself whether she thinks this is in fact wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们从哈斯佩尔本人那里并不知道她是否认为这确实是错误的。

sentences.en: But Bennett and I talked about that.
sentences.zh: 但班内特和我谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: And I would say the fact that they sent Gina Haspel, given her sound judgment and her balance,
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，鉴于她良好的判断力和平衡感——

sentences.en: emotional balance, I think she, if you're going to have that type of facility, that's exactly the
sentences.zh: 情绪平衡，我认为她，如果你要拥有那种类型的设施，那正是

sentences.en: type of officer you want there, not somebody who is a zealot or somebody who has lost their perspective on what it is that we're there for.
sentences.zh: 你希望在那里的那种官员，而不是狂热分子或对我们存在的目的失去远见的人。

sentences.en: I think it's unfair to assume that Gina is somebody who's an advocate for waterboarding.
sentences.zh: 我认为把吉娜假设为水刑的拥护者是不公平的。

sentences.en: I mean, that was one of the tools that was legally available at that site.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是该基地合法可用的工具之一。

sentences.en: But it's not a tool that she invented or advocated.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是她发明或倡导的工具。

sentences.en: So he's saying that Haspel was brought there because she's not somebody who's viewed as embracing the harshest possible tactics after 9-11 to deal with suspected terrorists.
sentences.zh: 所以他是说，哈斯佩尔被带到那里是因为她不被视为在9·11后对恐怖主义嫌疑人采取最严厉战术的支持者。

sentences.en: I think she's brought there because she wasn't going to let things get out of control.
sentences.zh: 我认为她被带到那里是因为她不会让事情失控。

sentences.en: Remember, that individual who was waterboarded under her time was only waterboarded three times.
sentences.zh: 记住，在她任职期间被实施水刑的那个人只被水刑了三次。

sentences.en: Now, for him, each one is an eternity.
sentences.zh: 当然，对他来说，每一次都是永恒。

sentences.en: But the previous individual, Abu Zubaydah, was waterboarded
sentences.zh: 但前一个人，阿布·祖拜达，被实施了

sentences.en: 83 times.
sentences.zh: 83次水刑。

sentences.en: That didn't happen under her watch there.
sentences.zh: 那在她值班期间是没有发生的。

sentences.en: Somebody described her job there as clean-up and close-up, which they did in December of 2002.
sentences.zh: 有人将她在那里工作描述为善后和收尾，他们在2002年12月完成了这项工作。

sentences.en: After Thailand, she returns to the counterterrorism center in Langley, Virginia, and she takes up a job as deputy to the chief of operations.
sentences.zh: 离开泰国后，她返回弗吉尼亚州兰利的反对中心，担任行动处副长官。

sentences.en: Jose Rodriguez, who is running the counterterrorism center at that time, thinks highly of her.
sentences.zh: 当时负责反中心何塞·罗德里格斯对她评价很高。

sentences.en: And what does he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: He plucks Haspel to be his chief of staff while he's running the clandestine service, which is a big job.
sentences.zh: 他在掌管秘密行动处这一重要工作时，挑选了哈斯佩尔担任他的办公厅主任。

sentences.en: And it's a signal to the rest of the building that Haspel is highly respected and she's going places.
sentences.zh: 这向大楼里其他人发出一个信号，即哈斯佩尔备受尊敬，她前途无量。

sentences.en: She's going to move up the ladder after this.
sentences.zh: 在此之后她会步步高升。

sentences.en: So she is promoted after this work in Thailand, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来她在泰国的这项工作之后得到了晋升。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Correct.

sentences.zh: 法律顾问哈里特·迈尔斯和中情局代理总法律顾问约翰·里佐曾明确指示何塞·罗德里格斯：不要销毁那些录像带。

sentences.zh: 然而呢？

sentences.en: And yet Jose felt he had all the legal authority he needed and pushed the button on that cable and those tapes were destroyed.
sentences.zh: 然而何塞觉得他拥有所需的所有合法授权，按下了那条电报的发送按钮，那些录像带就被销毁了。

sentences.en: The tapes are no more.
sentences.zh: 录像带不复存在了。

sentences.en: Jose Rodriguez destroyed them.
sentences.zh: 何塞·罗德里格斯销毁了它们。

sentences.en: They would have been devastating had they ever become public, but he remains unrepentant.
sentences.zh: 如果它们公之于众，将会造成毁灭性的影响，但他对此毫无悔意。

sentences.en: I am proud of the decisions that I took, including the destruction of the tapes to protect the people who work for me.
sentences.zh: 我为我做出的决定感到骄傲，包括为了保护为我工作的人而销毁录像带。

sentences.en: I have no regrets.
sentences.zh: 我毫无遗憾。

sentences.en: You had no qualMs.
sentences.zh: 你毫无内疚。

sentences.en: We made some Al-Qaeda terrorists with American blood on their hands, uncomfortable for a few days, but we did the right thing for the right reason.
sentences.zh: 我们让一些手上沾满美国人鲜血的基地组织恐怖分子难受了几天，但我们为了正确的理由做了正确的事。

sentences.en: And the right reason was to protect the homeland and to protect American lives.
sentences.zh: 而正确的理由是为了保护国土和保护美国人的生命。

sentences.en: So, yes, I had no qualMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我毫无内疚。

sentences.en: I can tell you that I fully supported Jose's decision because I thought it was necessary to protect our officers in the future.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，我全力支持何塞的决定，因为我认为这对于未来保护我们的官员是必要的。

sentences.en: There was no doubt in my mind that at some point in time, this material would get into the public domain.
sentences.zh: 我毫不怀疑，在某个时候，这些材料会进入公共领域。

sentences.en: Aggressive reporters like Adam Goldman would never have, couldn't have resisted the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 像亚当·戈德曼这样咄咄逼人的记者绝不会、也无法抗拒这个机会。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You're right on that count.
sentences.zh: 这一点你说得对。

sentences.en: And, you know, we wanted to protect our officers, not just from Al-Qaeda, but from the public perception of what they had been asked to do.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们希望保护我们的官员，不仅是为了让他们免受基地组织的威胁，也是为了让他们免受公众对他们奉命行事看法的保护。

sentences.en: It's my understanding that Gina was supportive of this.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，吉娜对此是支持的。

sentences.en: You know, she drafted the cable.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那份电报是她起草的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She was.
sentences.zh: 她确实起草了。

sentences.en: She drafted the cable, but let's be clear of what her role was.
sentences.zh: 她起草了电报，但我们要明确她的角色是什么。

sentences.en: Gina was the chief of staff.
sentences.zh: 吉娜是办公厅主任。

sentences.en: She wasn't the commander.
sentences.zh: 她不是指挥官。

sentences.en: Gina had no authority to order the destruction of the tapes, nor did she have any authority to countermand Jose's decision, any more than the chief of
sentences.zh: 吉娜没有权力下令销毁录像带，也没有权力撤销何塞的决定，就像

sentences.en: station who received that cable was in a position to ignore it.
sentences.zh: 收到那封电报的站长也无权忽视它一样。

sentences.en: So I think Jose's been very clear on every occasion that he and he alone made the decision to destroy those tapes.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得何塞在各个场合都说得很清楚，是他、而且只有他作出了销毁这些录像带的决定。

sentences.en: I think to most people, this order sounds like the CIA trying to cover up something that they knew, perhaps in their heart of hearts, was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想对大多数人来说，这个命令听起来像是中情局试图掩盖某些他们内心深处或许就知道是错误的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, destroying tapes as a student of American politics and history almost always feels like the definition of hiding something.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，作为一个美国政治和历史的研究者，销毁录像带几乎总是等同于隐藏秘密。

sentences.en: When the New York Times revealed that, in fact, these tapes have been destroyed, it was a huge scandal.
sentences.zh: 当《纽约时报》披露这些录像带实际上已经被销毁时，这是一桩巨大的丑闻。

sentences.en: What was on these tapes, and were they destroyed, and if so, by whom?
sentences.zh: 这些录像带里有什么，它们真的被销毁了吗？如果是的话，是谁干的？

sentences.en: The tapes were destroyed, and after the destruction, one of the big issues is that Congress was not notified.
sentences.zh: 录像带被销毁了，在销毁之后，其中一个核心问题是国会没有得到通知。

sentences.en: Many members of Congress, mostly Democrats, on Friday were calling for an attorney general investigation.
sentences.zh: 上周五，许多国会议员（主要是民主党人）呼吁总检察长进行调查。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: What do you think was on these tapes, and why do you think they were destroyed?
sentences.zh: 你认为这些录像带里有什么，你觉得它们为什么会被销毁？

sentences.en: Well, the suspicion, of course, is that the so-called enhanced interrogation techniques
sentences.zh: 嗯，大家的怀疑当然是，那些所谓的强化审讯手段

sentences.en: are depicted on those tapes, and so that's very significant, both because of what it means about
sentences.zh: 被记录在这些录像带里，所以这非常重要，不仅因为这意味着

sentences.en: the legality of the underlying conduct that's depicted on the tapes, and also the reliability of the information that came as the result of those interrogations.
sentences.zh: 录像带中所描绘的潜在行为的合法性，还因为这些审讯所获得信息的可靠性。

sentences.en: And there were real questions about whether laws had been broken, and in fact, under President Obama, federal prosecutors looked at whether a crime had been committed.
sentences.zh: 当时对于法律是否被打破存在真正的疑问，事实上，在奥巴马总统任内，联邦检察官曾调查是否犯下了罪行。

sentences.en: And I am certain that federal prosecutors interviewed Haspel about her role in this and her actions.
sentences.zh: 我确信联邦检察官曾就她在其中的角色和行动对哈斯佩尔进行过讯问。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: What effect, Adam, did Haspel's role in this episode have on her career at the CIA once the torture program became public?
sentences.zh: 亚当，一旦酷刑计划公开，哈斯佩尔在这个事件中所扮演的角色对她在中情局的职业生涯有什么影响？

sentences.en: It certainly seemed from the outside like this was a blight on the agency.
sentences.zh: 从外部看来，这无疑像是该机构的一个污点。

sentences.en: Was it considered a black mark on Haspel's record inside the CIA?
sentences.zh: 在中情局内部，这被认为是哈斯佩尔履历上的一个黑点吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: In fact, her career really took off.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她的职业生涯可以说是平步青云。

sentences.en: And Bennett and I talked about that.
sentences.zh: 我和本杰特谈过这件事。

sentences.en: The people who took on the hardest jobs at the most critical moments were widely respected.
sentences.zh: 那些在最关键时刻承担最艰巨工作的人受到了广泛的尊重。

sentences.en: They weren't seen as tainted.
sentences.zh: 他们并不被视为有污点的人。

sentences.en: And not just Gina Haspel.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是吉娜·哈斯佩尔。

sentences.en: I mean, people's careers were certainly not damaged by having taken part in our most aggressive programs, because those were the priorities
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，参与我们最激进计划的人的职业生涯绝对没有受到损害，因为那是当时总统和机构

sentences.en: of the president at the time and of the agency.
sentences.zh: 的首要任务。

sentences.en: And we put some of our very best officers into those programs, because if it's your most important priority, you want your best people working for it.
sentences.zh: 我们将一些最优秀的官员投入到这些计划中，因为如果这是你最重要的首要任务，你就会希望最优秀的人来做。

sentences.en: So the fact that Haspel and others worked on the torture program, it sounds like didn't at all
sentences.zh: 所以，哈斯佩尔和其他人参与酷刑计划的事实，听起来一点也没有

sentences.en: prevent them from rising through the ranks, that it actually boosted them, especially Haspel.
sentences.zh: 阻碍他们晋升，反而实际上推动了他们，尤其是哈斯佩尔。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Once Trump wins the election and becomes president, she's promptly named deputy director of the CIA, which is in its own right, is an extraordinary job at the agency.
sentences.zh: 一旦特朗普赢得大选并成为总统，她很快就被任命为中情局副局长，这本身就是该机构中一份非凡的工作。

sentences.en: And she's at the highest levels of power in the United States government.
sentences.zh: 而且她身处美国政府权力的最高层。

sentences.en: It's a big job.
sentences.zh: 这是一份重大工作。

sentences.en: And then President
sentences.zh: 然后总统

sentences.en: Trump decided he wanted Mike Pompeo, then director of the CIA, to become the next secretary of state.
sentences.zh: 特朗普决定让时任中情局局长的迈克·蓬佩奥出任下一任国务卿。

sentences.en: And now suddenly she's nominated to be the CIA director.
sentences.zh: 现在她突然被提名担任中情局局长。

sentences.en: So now that Haspel is the nominee, how are lawmakers thinking about these experiences that
sentences.zh: 既然哈斯佩尔现在成了被提名人， lawmakers（议员们）是如何看待我们一直在谈论的这些经历的——

sentences.en: we've been talking about, the waterboarding at the black site in Thailand and the destruction of
sentences.zh: 在泰国黑监狱实施的水刑，以及销毁

sentences.en: the tapes documenting this kind of interrogation, now that she's up for this far bigger job as these lawmakers prepare for her confirmation hearing on Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 记录这种审讯的录像带——现在她正在竞聘这个更重要的职位，而议员们正准备在周三为她举行听证会？

sentences.en: Haspel is going to face a tough confirmation hearing, in particular from Democratic senators and some Republican ones as well.
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔将面临一场艰难的确认听证会，特别是来自民主党参议员以及一些共和党参议员的质询。

sentences.en: And she knows it and they know it.
sentences.zh: 她心里清楚，他们也很清楚。

sentences.en: And this is what precipitated a crisis on Friday when Haspel went to the White House and basically said, look, I don't want to put
sentences.zh: 上周五正是这引发了一场危机，当时哈斯佩尔前往白宫，基本上是说，听着，如果你不承诺坚定支持我，

sentences.en: myself through this and the CIA through this and damage both of our reputations if you're not committed to standing behind me.
sentences.zh: 我不想让自己经历这一切，也不想让中情局经历这一切并损害我们双方的声誉。

sentences.en: And she had second thoughts and she offered to pull out of this thing and she thought about it.
sentences.zh: 她有些犹豫不决，并提出要退出这件事，她考虑过放弃。

sentences.en: And I think by Friday night, the crisis had been resolved and she said,
sentences.zh: 我想到了周五晚上，危机已经解决，她说，

sentences.en: OK, I'm going to do this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我要这么做。

sentences.en: I'm going to go forward with this.
sentences.zh: 我要继续推进。

sentences.en: And in fact, just today on Monday, she was spotted on the Hill walking confidently, meeting with senators.
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在今天周一，人们在国会山看到她自信地走着，与参议员们会面。

sentences.en: So the confirmation is on track.
sentences.zh: 所以提名确认工作正在按计划进行。

sentences.en: What's at stake from the point of view of these lawmakers who are going to be sitting across from Haspel and asking her these questions?
sentences.zh: 从这些将与哈斯佩尔面对面并向她提出这些问题的议员的角度来看，什么才是最重要的？

sentences.en: For them, what is the point of this hearing?
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这场听证会的意义何在？

sentences.en: I think for some senators, it's simply about electoral politics.
sentences.zh: 我认为对一些参议员来说，这纯粹关乎选举政治。

sentences.en: Some lawmakers want to send a message to their constituents that this behavior was OK and we support it.
sentences.zh: 一些议员希望向选民传达这样一个信息：这种行为是可以接受的，我们支持它。

sentences.en: And maybe their constituents actually believe that torture works or this program was effective.
sentences.zh: 也许他们的选民真的相信酷刑有用，或者这个计划是有效的。

sentences.en: And then there are other senators, certainly the senator from California, Dianne Feinstein, who's running for reelection.
sentences.zh: 还有其他一些参议员，比如正在竞选连任的加利福尼亚州参议员黛安·范斯坦。

sentences.en: This is her legacy.
sentences.zh: 这是她的政治遗产。

sentences.en: She actually led the investigation into all the bad stuff that happened during this program.
sentences.zh: 她实际上领导了对在这个计划期间发生的所有恶劣事件的调查。

sentences.en: For others, I think they have bigger concerns, such as what message they want to send to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 对其他人来说，我认为他们有更深远的担忧，比如他们希望向世界其他地方传达什么信息。

sentences.en: Are we going to support and confirm an individual who participated in what many people believe was torture, right?
sentences.zh: 我们是否要支持和确认一个参与了许多人认为属于酷刑的人，对吧？

sentences.en: What message do we send by confirming
sentences.zh: 通过确认

sentences.en: Haspel is the next director of the CIA?
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔为中情局下一任局长，我们传达了什么信息？

sentences.en: I mean, that is the big message.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这才是那个宏大的信息。

sentences.en: And I think our position as the leader of the free world, we set the tone.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们作为自由世界领导者的地位，我们定下了基调。

sentences.en: And how's the rest of the world going to react to that?
sentences.zh: 世界其他地方会对此作何反应？

sentences.en: They're going to say, well, I guess, is that OK?
sentences.zh: 他们会说，好吧，我猜，这可以接受吗？

sentences.en: That's the way I feel.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的感受。

sentences.en: Can you imagine?
sentences.zh: 你能想象吗？

sentences.en: Can you imagine these people, these animals over in the Middle East that chop off heads, sitting around talking and seeing that we're having a hard problem with waterboarding?
sentences.zh: 你能想象中东那些割人头的家伙、那些野兽，坐在一起谈论并看到我们在水刑问题上遇到了难题吗？

sentences.en: We should go for waterboarding and we should go tougher.
sentences.zh: 我们应该采用水刑，而且我们应该采取更严厉的手段。

sentences.en: They asked me, why do you think about waterboarding, Mr. Trump?
sentences.zh: 他们问我，特朗普先生，你对水刑怎么看？

sentences.en: I said, I love it.
sentences.zh: 我说，我喜欢它。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Look, it's great.
sentences.zh: 听着，这太棒了。

sentences.en: And I said, the only thing is we should make it much tougher than waterboarding.
sentences.zh: 我说，唯一的区别是我们应该让它比水刑严厉得多。

sentences.en: It feels like the critical question at Haspel's confirmation hearings will be whether as
sentences.zh: 感觉哈斯佩尔确认听证会上最关键的问题将是，作为中情局的最高官员，不再仅仅是一个下属，她是否愿意再次带领中情局走上这条路。

sentences.en: the top official of the CIA, not just a subordinate anymore, she would be willing to walk the CIA down this path again.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管她将管理中情局，但她仍然只对一个人负责，那就是总统。

sentences.en: Because even though she would be running the CIA, she still answers to one person, and that would be the president.
sentences.zh: 而这位总统本人就曾倡导过最激进的审讯形式。

sentences.en: And this president has himself advocated for the most aggressive forms of interrogation.
sentences.zh: 他对此似乎感到十分坦然。

sentences.en: He seems quite comfortable with them.
sentences.zh: 那么她现在会再次说“是”吗？

sentences.en: And so would she say yes again now?
sentences.zh: 本内特说，如果被要求的话，她不会再领导该机构走上那条路。

sentences.en: Bennett says she wouldn't lead the agency down that path again if asked to.
sentences.zh: 我认为她绝对会是那种不会害怕对总统说“这错了，这不明智，我们不干”的局长。

sentences.en: I think she would certainly be the type of director who would not be afraid to tell the president, this is wrong, and it's not smart, and we're not doing it.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们第二天可能会换一个新局长。

sentences.en: Now, they might have a new director the next day.
sentences.zh: 但我认为她绝对准备好付出这个代价来做正确的事情。

sentences.en: But I think she would certainly be prepared to pay that price to do what's right.
sentences.zh: 所以本内特的意思是，如果特朗普总统要求她这样做，总统可能会对她的回答感到非常失望，

sentences.en: So what Bennett is saying is that if President Trump were to ask her to do this, that the president
sentences.zh: 她会根据这个时代的教训说“不”。

sentences.en: might be very disappointed by her answer, that she would say no based on the lessons of this era.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 但这也让她面临一些相当严厉的质问，即她是否认为那是错误的。

sentences.en: But that would open her up to some pretty severe questioning about whether she thought it was wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果她认为那是错的，为什么一开始还要经历它？

sentences.en: And if she thought it was wrong, why did she go through it in the beginning?
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 如果当年她担任重要角色、本可以阻止它的时候觉得一次还可以，为什么我们要相信当她成为整个中情局的负责人时她不会重蹈覆辙？

sentences.en: If it was okay once when she had a very large role and could have stopped it, why should we believe that she won't do it again when she's the head of the entire CIA?
sentences.zh: 我想她可能不得不以各种形式多次回答这个问题，因为她将面对一些相当强硬的参议员。

sentences.en: And I think she's probably going to have to answer that question in various forms many times when she faces some pretty tough senators.
sentences.zh: 你认为约翰·本内特这个从不跟任何人说话的顶级间谍接受你采访的原因之一，是为了传达这样一个信息：哈斯佩尔将是对总统的一种制衡，她会对任何类似酷刑的东西说“不”？

sentences.en: And do you think that one of the reasons why John Bennett, this top spy who talks to no one,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为本内特和其他跟我谈过哈斯佩尔的人，他们相信她将成为对一个反复无常的总统的制衡，对吧？

sentences.en: said yes to your interview was to deliver this very message that Haspel would be a check on the president, that she would say no to anything resembling torture?
sentences.zh: 我想他们希望美国公众知道她是一个稳妥的选择。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think Bennett and others who have spoken to me about Haspel, they believe that she would be a check on an erratic president, right?
sentences.zh: 在混乱的时期，她是一个稳妥的选择。

sentences.en: And I think they want the American public to know that she's a safe bet.
